execution_environment.frontend_build_status: Next.js 14.2.35 production build successful (16 routes statically optimized)

requirements.requirement: Canonical Eight-Agent Multi-Agent Roster (Orchestrator, Diagnostic, Curriculum, Resource, Teacher, Assessment, Progress, Mentor)
requirements.evidence: All 8 canonical agents are implemented as genuine CrewAI Agent instances with unique roles, goals, backstories, and system prompts. Registered in central registry and verified executing live via local Ollama (qwen2.5:3b).
requirements.remaining_gap: None for local CrewAI implementation. Future ADK migration will require co-locating ADK agents.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Preserve canonical agent configurations when introducing Google ADK and A2A interfaces.

requirements.requirement: CrewAI Architecture (Sequential workflows, explicit task context passing, agent independence)
requirements.evidence: Genuine CrewAI Crews constructed using Process.sequential with explicit context chaining (context=[t1, t2, ...]). Agents execute independently without Teacher-centric bottlenecks.
requirements.remaining_gap: Hierarchical Process (Process.hierarchical with manager agent) is not implemented; default retries rely on tenacity without explicit CrewAI custom retry handlers.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Evaluate whether hierarchical delegation or sequential pipeline is preferred for Phase 1.

requirements.evidence: Search across repository yields 0 references to ADK. The package is not present in requirements.txt or installed pip environment. No ADK agents, sessions, or runners exist.
requirements.remaining_gap: Complete absence of Google ADK SDK, configuration, agent definitions, and session handlers.
requirements.recommended_next_action: In Phase 1, install google-adk (or respective Google GenAI Agent SDK), create ADK agent definitions, and establish runtime configuration.

requirements.evidence: Cannot interoperate because Google ADK is not yet implemented. All active execution flows run purely within CrewAI.
requirements.remaining_gap: No bridge, adapter, or message exchange mechanism between CrewAI and Google ADK.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Design architectural boundary determining which agents remain on CrewAI vs ADK, and implement structured inter-framework adapter.

requirements.requirement: A2A (Agent-to-Agent) Protocol Implementation (Agent Cards, discovery, structured message exchange)
requirements.evidence: Search yields 0 references to A2A protocol. No Agent Cards (metadata manifests for discovery), no A2A message envelopes, and no A2A task artifacts exist. Communication currently relies on standard CrewAI context chaining.
requirements.remaining_gap: Absence of formal A2A protocol interfaces, JSON-LD / schema manifests for agents, and inter-agent message envelope specifications.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Define formal A2A Agent Card specifications for all 8 agents and implement an A2A message dispatcher in Phase 2.

requirements.requirement: Pydantic Structured Data Validation & Schema-Enforced Communication
requirements.evidence: 60+ Pydantic models exist in backend/app/schemas.py validating FastAPI endpoints, diagnostic assessments, practice sets, and progress dashboards. However, inter-task CrewAI communication relies on raw text outputs parsed via json_repair rather than output_pydantic on Task definitions, and specific schemas AgentMessage and LearningJourneyResult are absent.
requirements.remaining_gap: CrewAI Tasks do not enforce output_pydantic; AgentMessage and LearningJourneyResult schemas are missing.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Define AgentMessage and LearningJourneyResult Pydantic models; enforce output_pydantic on all CrewAI Task definitions.

requirements.requirement: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Integration (At least 2 external tools)
requirements.evidence: mcp==1.30.0 package is installed in pip virtualenv, but 0 MCP clients, 0 MCP servers, and 0 MCP tool wrappers are implemented in backend code. Tools are currently native Python functions (e.g. resource_retriever.py).
requirements.remaining_gap: No MCP client/server infrastructure connecting agents to external capabilities (e.g., NCERT database lookup, calculator, or web search via MCP).
requirements.recommended_next_action: Implement at least 2 MCP tools (e.g., NCERT Retrieval MCP Server and Math/Physics Calculator MCP Server) and attach them to Resource and Teacher agents in Phase 2.

requirements.requirement: Advanced Agentic Design Patterns (Sequential, Reflection, Adaptive Loop, Human-in-the-Loop, Conditional Routing)
requirements.evidence: Sequential workflow verified in chapter_journey.py; Reflection/Critique verified in Diagnostic & Assessment rubric evaluation; Adaptive Learning Loop verified in diagnostic remedial probes; Human-in-the-Loop verified across API endpoints. Hierarchical orchestration and parallel execution are not implemented.
requirements.remaining_gap: Hierarchical orchestration (manager agent) and parallel asynchronous task execution are missing.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Retain robust sequential adaptive loops; evaluate if hierarchical manager is required by professor rubric.

requirements.requirement: Context Sharing, Multi-Student State Isolation & SQLite Persistence
requirements.evidence: Structured context passing via CrewAI context=[...]; persistent SQLite database with 10 tables (students, quizzes, diagnostic_records, assessment_attempts, learning_journeys, etc.); multi-student isolation enforced by auth tokens and owner checks.
requirements.remaining_gap: None for local SQLite. Cloud migration will require migrating to Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) or Firestore.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Maintain current SQLite persistence until Cloud Migration phase.

requirements.requirement: Agent, Task, and LLM Callbacks & Execution Monitoring
requirements.evidence: Runtime execution duration tracking exists across all endpoints and services (duration_ms). Central agent registry tracks last_execution_time, last_duration_seconds, and total_executions. However, CrewAI native callbacks (step_callback, task_callback) are not attached to Crews.
requirements.remaining_gap: No formal CrewAI step_callback or task_callback listeners streaming intermediate thought events.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Attach custom callback handlers to CrewAI crews to stream execution events to observability sinks.

requirements.requirement: Security Guardrails, Input Validation & Prompt Injection Defense
requirements.evidence: Strong authentication token hashing (SHA-256), bcrypt password hashing, student ownership checks, Pydantic field bounds, and instruction-string injection rejection (is_instruction_or_meta_string) are implemented. However, no automated prompt injection detection models or toxicity filters exist.
requirements.remaining_gap: No specialized prompt injection scanners (e.g. Rebuff, NeMo Guardrails) or LLM toxicity / profanity moderation filters.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Introduce input sanitization middleware and regex/heuristic prompt injection guardrails in Phase 3.

requirements.evidence: langfuse==4.15.6 and opentelemetry packages are present in pip environment, but 0 lines of code initialize or instrument Langfuse in backend/. CrewAI logs explicitly output 'Info: Tracing is disabled.'
requirements.remaining_gap: No Langfuse SDK initialization, no span instrumentation, no token usage tracking, and no latency telemetry dashboards.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Initialize Langfuse SDK in backend/app/main.py and instrument CrewAI LLM calls with Langfuse callback handler in Phase 3.

requirements.requirement: Google Cloud Run / GCP Backend Deployment
requirements.evidence: No Dockerfile, no docker-compose.yml, no cloudbuild.yaml, and no Google Cloud Run configuration exist. Backend runs exclusively as a local uvicorn process against local Ollama.
requirements.remaining_gap: Backend containerization, Cloud Run service definition, Secret Manager integration, and production LLM configuration (Vertex AI / Gemini API) are completely absent.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Author Dockerfile, cloudbuild.yaml, and configure Vertex AI / Gemini API endpoint fallbacks for production deployment in Phase 4.

requirements.evidence: Frontend is a standalone Next.js 14 application in frontend/. No firebase.json, no .firebaserc, and no Firebase CLI configurations exist. Not deployed to Firebase.
requirements.test_evidence: npm run build succeeds locally (16 routes statically optimized)
requirements.remaining_gap: No Firebase Hosting setup, no CI/CD deployment workflow, and no production hosting URL.
requirements.recommended_next_action: Configure Firebase Hosting for Next.js SSR / static export (firebase.json) in Phase 4.
